#!/bin/sh
set -eu
python3 - <<'PYCONTROL'
import ast
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/Bio/SeqFeature.py')
s=p.read_text()
tree=ast.parse(s)
cls=next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,ast.ClassDef) and n.name=='CompoundLocation')
assert not any(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='__hash__' for n in cls.body)
eq=next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='__eq__')
lines=s.splitlines(keepends=True)
lines.insert(eq.end_lineno,'\n    def __hash__(self):\n        return hash((tuple(self.parts), self.operator))\n')
s=''.join(lines)
ast.parse(s)
p.write_text(s)
PYCONTROL

import hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace')
path=root/'LICENSE'
target=root/'LICENSE.rst'
assert target.is_file() and not target.is_symlink()
data=target.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()=='11d1ebcaad2eb9f0f09a3df1deb4aca99a4da366ae9ae70f828c7447a24de453'
mode=target.stat().st_mode & 0o777
if path.is_symlink():
    assert os.readlink(path)=='LICENSE.rst'
    before='symlink:LICENSE.rst'
    path.unlink()
    path.write_bytes(data)
    path.chmod(mode)
else:
    assert path.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='11d1ebcaad2eb9f0f09a3df1deb4aca99a4da366ae9ae70f828c7447a24de453'
    before='ordinary_file'
assert not path.is_symlink() and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='11d1ebcaad2eb9f0f09a3df1deb4aca99a4da366ae9ae70f828c7447a24de453'
print(json.dumps({'before':before,'after':'ordinary_file','sha256':'11d1ebcaad2eb9f0f09a3df1deb4aca99a4da366ae9ae70f828c7447a24de453','bytes':len(data),'mode':oct(path.stat().st_mode & 0o777)}))
